extraction.name: DocVQA
extraction.description: A dataset for Visual Question Answering (VQA) on document images, consisting of 50,000 questions defined on 12,000+ document images.
extraction.creator: Minesh Mathew, Dimosthenis Karatzas, C.V. Jawahar
extraction.publisher: CVIT, IIIT Hyderabad, India; Computer Vision Center, UAB, Spain
extraction.rai:dataCollection: Images in the dataset are sourced from documents in the UCSF Industry Documents Library. Documents were downloaded from different collections and pages were hand-picked for use in the dataset.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionType: Secondary Data analysis, Document analysis, Manual Human Curator
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Minimized binarized images to avoid poor image quality. Prioritized pages with tables, forms, lists and figures over pages which only have running text.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: The annotation process was organized in three stages. Stage 1: Remote workers were shown a document image and asked to define at most 10 question-answer pairs, entering the answer verbatim from the document. Stage 2: A different worker was shown the image and questions (without stage 1 answers) and required to enter answers and assign question types. Stage 3: If answers from stage 1 and 2 did not match exactly, the question was sent for review by the authors, who accepted (after editing if necessary) or ignored it.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationAnalysis: During the second stage, if a worker found a question inapt owing to language issues or ambiguity, they could flag it, and such questions were excluded. Disagreement analysis was handled in a third stage: if none of the answers entered in the first stage matched exactly with any of the answers from the second stage, the question was sent for review and manually edited or ignored by the authors.
extraction.rai:annotationsPerItem: At most 10 question-answer pairs per document image. Each question was answered by at least two different workers across two stages, with a third stage review if there was a mismatch.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: Majority of documents in the source library are binarized, which takes a toll on image quality. Additionally, no OCR is perfect, and minor answer mismatches can stem from OCR errors.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Training, Validation, and Testing for Document Visual Question Answering (DocVQA). The data is split randomly in an 80:10:10 ratio.
